articles.title: Canada crypto remittances to Asian countries surge 141% to $2.36B: Chainalysis
articles.snippet: Remittance-sized crypto transfers from Canada to three Asian countries reached $2.36 billion, while transfers to the Philippines alone rose 28% to $61 million.
